name: Verify durable colonist state and continue after game-server restart

tests.name: Reauthenticate ordinary player and resolve active ship after restart

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.population=22 AND p.colonists_unassigned=22 AND s.colonists=3 AND c.quantity=3 AND p.population+c.quantity=25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='colonist_restart_owner') JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='COL' WHERE p.planet_id=977704

tests.name: Ordinary player picks up persisted colonists after restart
Post-restart transfer preserves population and cargo totals

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.population=19 AND p.colonists_unassigned=19 AND s.colonists=6 AND c.quantity=6 AND p.population+c.quantity=25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='colonist_restart_owner') JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='COL' WHERE p.planet_id=977704
